messages:
sam: Heads-up — promote for release/2.8.0 blocked: canary health-probe spiking 502s after routing tweak in #4780.

ci-bot: Canary pipeline failing: monitoring/health-check (exit 1) https://ci.internal/runs/110111 :x:

sam: Grafana alert shows probe failure: 5xx from edge -> backend pool draining during canary traffic shift.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for release/2.8.0 by CI gate (canary health-check failed) :warning:

ivy: Is this the new sticky-routing header change? Could be we send traffic to nodes that aren't warmed.

oz: yes, #4780 enabled weighted routing and increased probe aggressiveness. Locally fine, but on canary we see short cold starts + probe window too small.

sam: Options: 1) revert routing change 2) relax probe threshold for canary only 3) route less traffic to canary (slow rollout) 4) pin previous routing config and re-run.

ivy: Quickest low-risk: reduce probe sensitivity for canary (increase success window to 10s). I'll open tiny canary-config patch.

sam: If we relax probes, add note to roll back probe change in follow-up once we validate warm-up.

oncall-bot: Reminder: changing probe thresholds can mask real regressions. Please add canary-only flag and short TTL.

ivy: Patch: git checkout -b canary/probe-relax && yq -i '.canary.probe.window = 10' infra/canary.yml && git commit -am "relax canary health probe window to avoid cold-start false positives" && git push origin canary/probe-relax

ci-bot: Manual rerun link: https://ci.internal/manual/110111?action=rerun

ci-bot: Rerun result: health-check passed at 1761240180, canary steady with 0.1% 5xx over 5m.

deploy-bot: Promotion resumed for release/2.8.0. Canary promoted to eu-central-1.

oz: Good. We should schedule INFRA-1302 to add a warm-up step or gradual traffic increase for weighted routing.

sam: Release note snippet: "Temporarily relaxed canary health-check window due to transient cold-starts when enabling weighted routing. Follow-up: INFRA-1302 to implement warm-up + gradual traffic shift."

ivy: Action items: ivy -> revert probe relax after warm-up rollout is in place, oz -> INFRA-1302 ticket and test plan, sam -> add release-note/changelog.

oncall-bot: Monitoring alert will stay muted for 30m for canary-probe.

sam: Closing provisional hold for now, will reopen if metrics degrade. :eyes:
